subject: Re: Kickoff: advice-based moment estimation — staffing + compute
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Umar Costa 50% leads the estimation work and owns the baseline comparisons; Freya Ruiz 30% on the advice-model architecture; Vera Egede 25% on the telemetry data plumbing — she's heavily committed elsewhere until June, so her share rises to 40% after the 1st.

Compute: the sampling experiments themselves are CPU-heavy but cheap. The expensive part is training advice models on 90 days of telemetry history. We hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-22 — for training the advice models at full telemetry scale, and the June milestones are sequenced around that week. Before then, prototyping fits on 16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort.

One scoping note from Umar: for the graph inputs we'll validate on temporal graphs too (the "u v time" edge format), since the telemetry team's flows are inherently timestamped and advice staleness is the thing that will actually decide adoption.

Ivo
